messages:
morgan: Starting config-only deploy for tenant limiter + short timeouts. Canary 7% -> 35% over 30m. deploy-bot will post updates.
deploy-bot: deployctl: start rollout id=cfg-slowflow-2026 canary=7% change_window=30m
chi: Config summary:
- per_tenant_qps: 2
- tenant_burst: 8
- request_timeout_ms: 10000
- stream_timeout_ms: 9000
- routing_policy: latency-first

ops-bot: Temp alert rule set: cfg-slowflow-95p > 1.0s for 7m -> notify #eng-oncall
dan: Oncall here. I'll watch 95p, error-rate, and kvcache. Abort conditions: 95p>1s for 7m OR error rate +20%.
morgan: Ramp plan: 7% -> 20% after 10m -> 35% after 25m. Pin canary to model:v1.1-stable.
deploy-bot: update: canary increased to 20% after health checks passed.
chi: If we need rollback: `deployctl rollback cfg-slowflow-2026 --to=previous`. I'll also revert routing pin if we abort.
dan: If I trigger rollback I'll post a short incident summary here and ping product. :thumbsup:
morgan: Thanks team. Will post release notes post-window; note this is config-only, expected behavior unchanged.
